camel_example: aliyun aideepsign CreateWatermarkEmbedTask --region cn-hangzhou --FileType video --WatermarkContent 'wm-e2e-85970647' --Level '"1"' --version 2026-05-11 --method POST --force
description_en: Submits an invisible watermark embedding task to embed specified watermark content into an image, video, or audio file, and returns a task ID for asynchronous querying of the embedded output
description_zh: 提交暗水印嵌入任务，将指定的水印内容嵌入图片、视频或音频文件，返回任务 ID 用于异步查询嵌入产物
kebab_example: aliyun aideepsign create-watermark-embed-task --file-type video --watermark-content wm-e2e-85970647 --level '"1"' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWatermarkEmbedTask

parameters.help_en: The reserved idempotency field. This field is not supported. Passing this field does not cause an error, but it does not produce an idempotency effect
parameters.help_zh: 预留幂等字段，暂不支持。传入不会报错，但当前不产生幂等效果
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The file type. Valid values: image, video, and audio. The value must match the actual file type. When the input is audio, the output is always in WAV format
parameters.help_zh:
文件类型，取值：image（图片）、video（视频）、audio（音频），须与实际文件类型一致。
当输入为音频时，产物恒为 WAV格式
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.help_en: The URL of the file to be processed. The URL must be publicly accessible. Provide a presigned URL of an Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket in the same region as the called site (Hangzhou site -> regions in the Chinese mainland, Singapore site -> ap-southeast-1). For more information, see the request description
parameters.help_zh: 须为公网可访问的 URL；推荐提供与所调用站点同地域的阿里云 OSS 预签名 URL（杭州站点→国内地域，新加坡站点→ap-southeast-1），详见请求说明
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en: The watermark content. The embedded output can be used to restore this text by calling the extraction operation
parameters.help_zh: 水印内容。嵌入产物可由提取接口还原该文本
parameters.name: watermark_content

parameters.help_en: The embedding strength. Valid values: integers from 0 to 3. A higher strength indicates better robustness but lower visual quality
parameters.help_zh: 嵌入强度，取值为 0-3 的整数。强度越高鲁棒性越好、视觉质量越差
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: The reserved field. No valid values are available. Do not pass this field when calling the operation
parameters.help_zh: 预留字段，当前无有效取值，建议调用时不传
parameters.name: reserved

Code.description_en: The business error code. If the request is successful, "OK" is returned
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 "OK"

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. If the request is successful, 200 is returned
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 200

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the invisible watermark embedding task. You can call the GetWatermarkEmbedTaskResult operation to query the result
TaskId.description_zh: 暗水印嵌入任务 ID，用于调用 `GetWatermarkEmbedTaskResult` 查询结果
TaskId.title_en: 暗水印嵌入任务ID，用于后续GetWatermarkEmbedTaskResult查询
TaskId.title_zh: 暗水印嵌入任务ID，用于后续GetWatermarkEmbedTaskResult查询
